I found three behaviour changes on `refactor/modules` and fixed all three. The tests pass (517 of 517), but they didn't cover any of these three, so I only checked the diff against `main` by eye. I haven't committed anything.

1. **FX rates (`src/currency.js`):** every rate had been changed to the values from the "refresh display rates to the 2026-11-21 close" commit. I put back `main`'s rates and kept the single-quote, no-semicolon style.
2. **Unknown discount codes (`src/discount.js`):** an unknown code returned 0 instead of throwing `unknown code: X`. It now throws again.
3. **Line item quantity (`src/lineItems.js`):** the new `assertInt` call allowed `qty` of 0, where `main` required at least 1. It's back to a minimum of 1.

The rate change was an intentional commit, so if you do want the new rates, land them in a separate PR rather than in this refactor. The other files (`tax`, `money`, `render`, `invoice`, `validate`) match `main` in behaviour.
